parts: I need a thorough comparison between running weekly sprints with three engineers using a Kanban board versus running strict calendar milestones in a software team where one engineer works full-time, one engineer is part-time, and one is contractor support, including communication rituals, expected velocity assumptions, handoff format, outage risk, and how to keep everyone aligned when the part-time schedule changes. Please evaluate onboarding costs, review rhythm, and what metrics we should keep for the first eight weeks.
I can break that down by process, communication, and risk.
Let's make it practical and include a one-page starter template.
Template included. I will keep this concise.
